A human behind
every interface.

I’m sp1ne. I build software, explore new technologies and turn ideas into projects of my own.

I started with frontend development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Vue.js. Then I began exploring backend development to understand how applications work beyond the interface.

I’m currently learning Rust and working on my own project. I enjoy trying different approaches, exploring new tools and finding solutions independently.

Next, I want to explore machine learning and artificial intelligence, gain more hands-on experience and bring my own ideas to life.

Always learning, experimenting and working on new projects.

How I work

A clear idea and a working draft.
A thoughtful review of the details.

  1. 01

    Understand the idea

    We’ll talk through your idea.
    Find the audience and purpose.
    Decide what the site should do.

  2. 02

    Build the foundation

    We’ll shape the look and layout.
    I’ll build a first version with AI.
    Then we’ll review it together.

  3. 03

    Refine the details

    We’ll check the mobile layout.
    Review it on a larger screen.
    And refine the final details.

Let’s talk ideas.
And build a site.

Tell me what you have in mind. A few sentences or a link to a website you like is a good place to start.
